name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Touch reliability fix for V0.57: Orbit taps no longer require a prior face-up interaction state. Keep the watch unlocked for app input, immediately undo unexpected lock events, and accept screen taps whenever the LCD is on. Preserve the 400 ms single/double-tap split, integrated 5wCal module, optimized renderer, and BTN1 launcher exit.
